_comment: Faction warfare and mutiny system data for E12 Divided. Ship sections, faction goals, mutiny events, moral choices, and Rush's secret agenda. Loaded by faction_system.gd and mutiny_system.gd.

gate_room.description: Central hub. Controls the Stargate — the only way on or off Destiny.

control_interface_room.description: Main bridge consoles. Ship navigation, life support, power distribution.

engineering.description: FTL drive, power junctions, life support machinery.

observation_deck.description: Long-range sensors, communication stones, viewing lounge.

eli_quarters.description: Living section. Where the civilians sleep and eat.

med_bay.description: TJ's domain. Medical supplies, triage, injury recovery.

mess_hall.description: Food, water, and social hub. Everyone passes through here.

aft_storage_hall.description: Cargo, spare parts, the junction room. Resource bottleneck.

south_corridor.description: Primary access corridor between the gate room and engineering.

north_corridor.description: Secondary corridor connecting quarters to the observation deck.

military.primary: Maintain order and chain of command. Keep the ship's critical systems under military control.
military.secondary: Protect the crew. Establish defensive positions. Ensure readiness for hostile encounters.
military.failure_condition: Loses control of gate_room for more than 2 phases.

science.primary: Unlock Destiny's secrets. Rush believes the ship's mission takes priority over military command.
science.secondary: Control engineering and the observation deck. Study Ancient technology without interference.
science.success_condition: Controls engineering and observation_deck, and Rush's trust >= 50.
science.failure_condition: Rush arrested or removed from duty.

civilian.primary: Survival and democracy. Civilians deserve a voice in how the ship is run.
civilian.secondary: Control the living sections. Organize protests, negotiate, and resist military overreach.
civilian.success_condition: Civilian council formed with at least 3 sections under civilian control.
civilian.failure_condition: Civilian morale drops below hostile for 3+ crew members.

lucian_alliance.primary: Exploit the chaos. Seize opportunities when the crew is divided.
lucian_alliance.secondary: Gain trust, gather intelligence, and position for a power grab.
lucian_alliance.success_condition: Any other faction fails and Lucian Alliance controls at least 2 sections.
lucian_alliance.failure_condition: Varro and Simeon both reach hostile relationship level.

food_shortage.title: Food Shortage
food_shortage.description: Rations are running low. The civilians are hungry and angry. Camille demands a vote on ration distribution.

choices.label: Military priority rations
choices.description: Soldiers eat first. They need the energy to defend the ship.

choices.label: Equal distribution
choices.description: Everyone gets the same. Fair, but soldiers may not have enough energy for combat.

choices.label: Science gets extra
choices.description: Rush argues the scientists need calories to solve the life support problems.

rush_secret_project.title: Rush's Secret Project
rush_secret_project.description: Eli discovers Rush has been using the control interface room after hours to access the ship's master code. He's trying to unlock the bridge — a section only the captain should authorize.

choices.label: Report Rush to Young
choices.description: Tell Colonel Young about Rush's secret access. This is a breach of trust and chain of command.

choices.label: Confront Rush privately
choices.description: Talk to Rush alone. Give him a chance to explain before going to Young.

choices.label: Help Rush unlock the bridge
choices.description: Rush says the bridge holds the key to getting home. Trust him.

civilian_protest.title: Civilian Protest
civilian_protest.description: Camille leads a group of civilians to occupy the mess hall. They refuse to leave until Young agrees to democratic elections. The military is surrounding the mess hall.

choices.label: Support Young — clear the protest
choices.description: Order must be maintained. The military removes the protesters by force if necessary.

choices.label: Negotiate a compromise
choices.description: Mediate between Young and Camille. Propose a civilian advisory council with real authority.

choices.label: Join the protest
choices.description: Eli stands with the civilians. The military has gone too far.

lucian_infiltration.title: Lucian Alliance Infiltration
lucian_infiltration.description: Varro approaches Eli with intelligence: Simeon has been secretly mapping the ship's weak points. Varro offers to help neutralize Simeon — but he wants access to the armory in return.

choices.label: Trust Varro — give armory access
choices.description: Varro has been loyal so far. Let him handle Simeon.

choices.label: Arrest Simeon — military operation
choices.description: Tell Young about Simeon's mapping. Let the military handle it.

choices.label: Confront Simeon yourself
choices.description: Eli tries to talk Simeon down. Dangerous, but avoids a military escalation.

final_standoff.title: The Final Standoff
final_standoff.description: The ship is divided. Rush has locked himself in the control interface room. Young is preparing to breach. Eli stands in the middle — his choice will determine who controls Destiny.

choices.label: Side with Young — restore military command
choices.description: The chain of command exists for a reason. Young should be in control.

choices.label: Side with Rush — unlock the bridge
choices.description: Rush is right. The ship's mission is bigger than who sits in the captain's chair.

choices.label: Broker a coalition government
choices.description: Neither side should have absolute power. Propose a council with military, science, and civilian representation.

rush_agenda.description: Rush's secret agenda: he believes Destiny's true mission is more important than the crew's survival. He has been secretly working to unlock the bridge and gain control of the ship's navigation. His ultimate goal is to steer Destiny toward its original Ancient mission objective, regardless of what the crew wants.

stages.name: Information Gathering
stages.description: Rush quietly accesses ship systems, mapping the bridge lockout codes.

stages.name: Building Leverage
stages.description: Rush uses the crew division to position himself as indispensable. He needs control of engineering and the control interface room.

stages.name: Bridge Unlock
stages.description: With enough control, Rush attempts to unlock the bridge and take command of Destiny's navigation.

stages.name: The Reveal
stages.description: Rush reveals the ship's true mission to the crew — or Eli exposes him first.

outcomes.rush_reported: Rush is arrested. The military maintains control but loses access to the ship's deeper secrets.
outcomes.rush_confronted: Rush agrees to share his findings with Eli. They form a fragile alliance.
outcomes.rush_helped: Rush gains control of the bridge. He reveals Destiny's mission but the crew is deeply divided.
outcomes.rush_agenda_revealed_military: Young gains control and puts Rush in the brig. The mission remains a mystery.
outcomes.rush_agenda_revealed_science: Rush takes command of the bridge and sets course for the mission objective.
outcomes.rush_agenda_revealed_coalition: The coalition agrees to pursue the mission together, with Rush as science advisor.

negotiation._comment: Negotiation parameters for the dialogue system. Each faction has negotiation strength based on their relationship with Eli and the sections they control.
